description: ChatGPT Edu is officially available for Johns Hopkins University full-time faculty and staff, providing an enterprise higher-education version with advanced features and privacy controls.
howToObtain: Submit account request with cost center; accept invitation via JHEDID@JH.EDU (full-time faculty and staff)
costToUser: $8.50 base monthly cost plus actual usage

evidence.evidenceSnippet: ChatGPT Edu is now officially available for Johns Hopkins University full-time faculty and staff. If you are not a full-time faculty or staff member at the university, you will need to speak with your divisional technical teams to explore available options. Before submitting an account request, please take a moment and read the resources on this page: https://engineering.jhu.edu/cmts/jhu-chatgpt-edu-account-request-for-faculty-and-staff/

JHU ChatGPT EDU Beyond the $8.50 base monthly cost for your account, you will be charged for actual usage.
ChatGPT Edu is the enterprise version of ChatGPT but with advanced features and privacy controls specific to education. https://openai.com/chatgpt/education/
Models & limits: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11165333-chatgpt-enterprise-models-limits
After the form is submitted with your cost center, our team will send you an invite. You must login with your JHEDID@JH.EDU.

description: HopGPT (formerly Hopkins AI Lab) is Johns Hopkins University's institutional AI platform developed by IT@JH, offering secure access to LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. Approved for sensitive data (PHI and PII) under institutional stewardship, subject to required IRB/SIP research approvals.
howToObtain: Sign in with JHED credentials at https://hopgpt.it.jh.edu
costToUser: Free of charge to JHU and JHM faculty, staff, and students

evidence.evidenceSnippet: HopGPT (formerly Hopkins AI Lab) offers members of the Johns Hopkins community secure and easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) from industry leaders including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. Developed by IT@JH, this secure environment mitigates security and privacy risks while ensuring that data remains protected.

HopGPT is approved for sensitive data, including PHI and PII. In accordance with Johns Hopkins University and Johns Hopkins Medicine policies, you must act in a manner consistent with appropriate use of PHI/PII and be a responsible steward of the data you enter into and collect from HopGPT.Note: IRB approval is required for non-clinical research cases and SIP approval required for any clinical research cases or uses involving PHI or PII data.

description: JHED-authenticated Microsoft Copilot web service. Free and enterprise-secured, but not HIPAA-compliant and not connected to M365 apps or internal data.
howToObtain: Select Continue with Microsoft, log in with JHEDID and password, then select Work

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Microsoft Copilot (Web Version)
Copilot on the web is free, is not HIPAA-compliant, and is not connected to your M365 apps or data.
Uses web-based data and the latest large language models (like GPT-5) to generate responses.
Does not access your organization's internal data (emails, documents, meetings, etc.).
Useful for general productivity, research, and task automation.
Offers enterprise-grade security and compliance
*During our testing we found that Microsoft Copilot worked effectively with uploaded documents such as Word and Excel files.
Select Continue with Microsoft to login with your JHEDID and password.
After signing in select Work
You can now start chatting with CoPilot

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Microsoft 365 Copilot
Copilot for M365 is available for $215/user/year. This version is HIPAA-compliant and connects with your M365 apps and data. Order from the Software Catalog.

Uses your organization's internal data (emails, chats, documents, calendar, etc.) via Microsoft Graph to provide context-aware, work-grounded responses.
Includes advanced features like:
Copilot in-app experiences (e.g., summarizing emails in Outlook, generating slides in PowerPoint).

description: IT@JH offers institutional licenses for Anthropic's Claude to faculty, staff, researchers, and students, providing secure access to Claude Chat and Claude Code with internal university security controls. Standard is approved for internal JHU data (including HR and finance) on recharge, but is not HIPAA-compliant and not approved for PHI. JHU-Medical accounts required for SoM/SoN/PHI work are HIPAA-compliant, do not include Cowork, and require additional attestation/training for Claude Code. Fable 5 requires Premium and is unavailable on JHU-Medical Premium. Cowork and Science are unavailable. Chats/artifacts retained 180 days from activity, projects 365 days. Tool licensing does not confer coursework or exam authorization.
howToObtain: Request through the Johns Hopkins AI Management Portal on campus or via VPN; requires cost-center recharge and fiscal year commitment. Requires active JHU affiliation and age 18+.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: We are offering two license levels: Standard ($22/month) and Premium ($55/month). Premium offers higher usage limits. Beyond usage caps, Standard and Premium are identical with one exception: a Premium license is currently required to access the Fable 5 model.

Purchasing a license requires a commitment for the fiscal year.  Your monthly charges begin in the month you request the license. If you start with a standard license, you can upgrade during the fiscal year. If you have a premium license, you will not be allowed to downgrade during the fiscal year.

To request this service, please visit the Johns Hopkins AI Management Portal. You will need to be on-campus or on the Johns Hopkins VPN for the link to work. You must request whether you would like Standard ($22/month) or Premium ($55/month).

This environment is approved for use with internal JHU data, including HR and finance data, and includes additional security controls to protect your data. Access is tied to the university financial system on a cost-recovery basis (recharge). This environment is not approved for personal health information (PHI) and is not HIPAA-compliant.

If your work requires a HIPAA-compliant environment, you have access to any protected health information (PHI), or you are part of the School of Medicine or School of Nursing, you will require JHU-Medical Claude access, also available in Standard and Premium as described above. This environment is approved for PHI and is HIPAA-compliant. JHU-Medical Claude will not include Cowork, and will require additional attestation and training for Claude Code access.
*Fable access is unavailable with the JHU-Medical Premium option.

Chats and artifacts are retained for 6 months (180 days) from their last activity. After 6 months with no activity, they are automatically deleted. Projects are retained for 1 year (365 days) from their last activity. After 1 year with no activity, they are automatically deleted.

Johns Hopkins community members have two license options (with different usage limits) for secure access to Anthropic’s Claude: Standard and Premium. Both include full capabilities of Claude Chat and Claude Code, including web search, chat history, and profile settings. Claude Cowork is not currently available, but coming soon. Claude Science is not currently available.

If your work requires a HIPAA-compliant environment, you have access to any protected health information (PHI), or you are part of the School of Medicine or School of Nursing, you will require JHU-Medical Claude access, also available in Standard and Premium as described above. This environment is approved for PHI and is HIPAA-compliant. JHU-Medical Claude will not include Cowork, and will require additional attestation and training for Claude Code access.

Claude licenses are available to members of the Johns Hopkins community who want to use generative AI in their work. This includes:
Staff, faculty, researchers, and students who:
Have an active Johns Hopkins University affiliation
Are at least 18 years of age

description: Zoom AI Companion provides automated meeting summaries and smart recordings for active, licensed Johns Hopkins Zoom accounts. Because student education records are considered PII under FERPA, meeting hosts should not enable AI Companion features if meetings involve student education records. Summaries and smart recordings are deleted after 180 days.
howToObtain: Included at no additional charge for all Licensed Zoom accounts in the Johns Hopkins enterprise; not supported for Basic or free accounts.
costToUser: Included with licensed institutional Zoom accounts (no additional user fee).

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Access
AI Companion is included, at no additional charge, for all Licensed Zoom accounts in the Johns Hopkins enterprise. AI Companion is not supported for Basic or free accounts. For instructions on how to enable AI Companion tools, visit ⁠this page.

Additionally, please note that because JHU considers student education records to be Personally Identifiable Information (PII), meeting hosts should not enable any of the AI Companion features if meetings will involve student education record data.
Meeting Summaries and Smart Recordings will be deleted after 180 days, following the Johns Hopkins retention policy for regular Zoom Cloud Recordings
